name: Core data sheet and change management
about: The company core data sheet (CCDS) and its safety subset (CCSI), mapping local labels to it, the deviation register, labelling change requests (including FDA safety labelling changes under section 505(o)(4)), agency comment rounds and implementation tracking. Company targets are training defaults; real companies set their own in their procedures.

targets.note: Submit and implementation targets are training defaults (the same defaults as the Variations Classifier). The 505(o)(4) clocks come from the statute as described in FDA guidance; a PRAC recommendation sets its own deadline.

kinds.label: New or strengthened warning or precaution
